label: Bible Study
prompt: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art _____ to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
verse: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
note: Heaven's new song — the Lamb alone can open the sealed book, because he was slain and redeemed us.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thou hast made known to me the ways of _____; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
verse: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
note: Peter quotes Psalm 16 at Pentecost: God makes known the ways of life and fills us with joy in His presence.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a _____, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
verse: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
note: Modern versions say rattling; the KJV says a noise and a shaking — and the dry bones came together, bone to his bone.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be _____, and do exploits.
verse: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.
note: Amid prophecies of a flattering tyrant, a promise: people who know their God will stand firm and act.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be _____ from thee.
verse: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
note: Job's final confession: God can do every thing, and 'no thought can be withholden from thee.' The questions finally rest.
